description: T4-3: the reachable flag uses d > 0 instead of d >= 0, so every entry node (BFS depth 0, which includes every file node) is reported unreachable.

target.find: reachable = np.array([1.0 if d >= 0 else 0.0 for d in bfs_depth], dtype=np.float64)
target.replace: reachable = np.array([1.0 if d > 0 else 0.0 for d in bfs_depth], dtype=np.float64)
